measurement.method: continuous segment distance with adaptive curve Hausdorff bounds
measurement.nearestPoints: points on the bounded polyline approximation; exact for original straight segments
measurement.connections: shared original drawn endpoints or exact original straight intersections only; never ink contact
measurement.scope: disconnected centerline components, not spacing inside a connected component

spacing.reason: No disconnected centerline components to compare.

circle_hole_exception.scope: Complete circular contours only; hole gate only. Spacing, pinch and other checks still apply.

internal_spacing.notice: Advisory sampled opposing-edge check; ordinary joins and complete circular contours excluded. Negative gap indicates overlapping ink.
